FIBRELOOP

FIBRELOOP turns flax straw, hemp hurds and other agricultural residues into fibres for nonwovens and yarn blends. The Interreg North-West Europe project runs from 2021 to 2025 with partners in the Netherlands, Belgium and France.

Results so far

Pilot batches of 70/30 hemp-cotton yarn passed knitting trials. An open dataset of fibre length and strength per residue type is available to project partners and SMEs on request.
